name: DocumentNamingRule
label: Document Naming Rule
description: Another naming series for documents that meet a condition: a separate count for a department, a document type, a year. The first enabled rule (highest priority first) whose condition holds names the new document instead of the DocType's autoname.

fields.label: Naming pattern
fields.description: Like the DocType's autoname: .YYYY. .YY. .MM. .DD., counter .####., a field's value in braces {department}. Everything before the counter has its own count.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: Rules with a higher priority are tried first

fields.label: Condition
fields.description: Python expression on the new document, e.g. doc.department == 'ЦНАП'. Empty: every document. An expression that fails counts as false.
